title: 顺劈斩
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：左、刺、右。左击后假装直刺，再以右击沿对手武器切入。
second_page: 直刺只是诱饵。等对手追着剑尖移动，右击便贴着他的兵器滑进去。

en_us.title: Oben Abnehmen
en_us.first_page: Input: Left, Thrust, Right. Feint a thrust after the left strike, then enter along the opponent's weapon from the right.
en_us.second_page: The thrust is only bait. Once the opponent follows the point, let the right strike slide in along their weapon.
